fields.description: Master switch for the AWS bulk-messaging execution plane. Off means every client's request_upload_url is refused.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Leave blank to use this bench's ambient credentials (instance profile / env).
fields.label: Access Key ID

fields.description: Never leaves this site. Client workspaces receive presigned URLs, never a key.
fields.label: Secret Access Key

fields.description: Lifetime of a presigned PUT URL. Long enough to upload a large manifest, short enough that a leaked URL is worthless quickly.
fields.label: Presign Expiry (seconds)

fields.description: Ceiling enforced in the presigned URL's content-length-range condition. A client cannot upload more than this, whatever it claims.
fields.label: Max Manifest Bytes

fields.description: Campaigns with recipients <= this threshold route via the client's Frappe Standard engine. Campaigns with > threshold recipients route via AWS.
fields.label: Min Recipient Threshold (Standard Engine Limit)

fields.description: MessagingApiUrl from the stack outputs. Used for the brokered analytics read; never sent to a client.
fields.label: API Gateway Base URL

fields.description: Must match the AnalyticsApiKey stack parameter. Secures GET /analytics.
fields.label: Analytics API Key

fields.description: Must match the RelayToken stack parameter. Authenticates the webhook Lambda to this site — it is not a client credential.
fields.label: Relay Token

fields.description: AWS Secrets Manager prefix. A client's gateway credentials resolve to <prefix>/<channel>/<client_code> — the provider names the secret, the client never sees it.
fields.label: Secret Prefix
